# BiodataCraft

> BiodataCraft is a privacy-first, free Indian matrimonial biodata maker web application. It enables candidates and families to create auspicious, publication-grade Hindu, Muslim, Jain, Sikh, and Christian marriage biodata PDFs in English and Hindi with zero signup and zero data storage.

## Core Features
- [Biodata Creator](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/create): Interactive client-side matrimonial biodata builder with real-time vector preview and customizable themes.
- [Biodata Templates](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/templates): Cultural, traditional, modern, and royal wedding biodata templates.
- [Sample Biodatas](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/samples): Curated sample biodata formats with auspicious Vedic mantras, horoscope/kundali details, and family backgrounds.
- [Marriage Biodata Guides](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/marriage-biodata): Comprehensive format guidelines, tips, and cultural etiquette.
- [Community Biodata Directory](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/biodata): Over 500 regional, caste, and cultural biodata formats across India.

## Knowledge & Cultural Formats
- [Hindu Marriage Biodata](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/hindu-marriage-biodata): Traditional Hindu biodata formats with Gotra, Rashi, Nakshatra, and Ganesh mantras.
- [Muslim Marriage Biodata](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/muslim-marriage-biodata): Auspicious Nikah biodata formats featuring Bismillah and Masnoon Duas.
- [Marathi Biodata](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/marathi-biodata): Lagna biodata formats in Marathi and English with Kula Daivat and Devak details.
- [Bengali Marriage Biodata](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/bengali-marriage-biodata): Traditional Patro/Patri matrimonial biodatas for Bengali families.
- [Yadav Marriage Biodata](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/yadav-marriage-biodata): Auspicious community biodata formats for Yadav families.

- [About Us](https://biodata-craft.vercel.app/about): Our privacy-first client-side architecture and mission.
